items.title: Goldman Sees Inflation Cooling by the end of 2027
items.summary: Goldman Sachs expects inflation to cool to 2.4% by the end of 2027 as tariff, energy and AI-related pressures fade. But Goldman's Chief US Economist David Mericle says the Fed may still raise rates in December and March, waiting for clearer evidence that inflation is easing.

items.summary: Four big banks keep lifting their payouts, yet each one hides a different threat to the next raise. One cut its dividend to a dime, and another sits on a capital cushion that is shrinking fast. Which check can retirees trust most?

items.title: SpaceX Falls 5%, Breaks Below IPO Price as Lenders Reportedly Balk at Musk’s Orbital AI Chip Plans; Rocket Lab Drops 3%, AST SpaceMobile Dips
items.summary: Lenders reportedly wanted to keep Elon Musk from launching the very chips securing his massive AI financing into orbit. Now bond buyers are demanding a steep premium, and the fallout is rattling SpaceX shareholders.
